name: How do I choose the right contractor for my backyard tiny home project?
description: Choose a contractor based on their experience with ADUs, local expertise, licensing, references, and transparent communication and bidding practices.

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my backyard tiny home project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor involves evaluating their experience, licensing, and portfolio of similar projects. Look for builders specializing in ADUs or tiny homes who understand local regulations in areas like Vista, Oceanside, Carlsbad, San Marcos, and Escondido. Request references, review their communication style, and ensure their bid is comprehensive and transparent. A good contractor will guide you through the entire process, from design to final inspection.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor based on their experience with ADUs, local expertise, licensing, references, and transparent communication and bidding practices.
